newsitem.title: UK: Avis Europe to raise 267 mln stg from shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Avis Europe to raise 267 mln stg from shr offer.

text.p: Car rental group Avis Europe Plc said on Wednesday it expected to raise 267 million stg by offering 215 million shares at 124 pence a share.
Avis said the global offer had been heavily subscribed with conditional dealings in the shares to begin on Wednesday. Unconditional details would start from April 4.
Of the money raised, Avis would use 106 million stg for repurchasing the shareholding and options of General Motors in the firm.
The offer price of 124 pence a share values the equity share capital of Avis Europe at 722 million stg.
